import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
const machineUnits = () => (process.env.FIXTURE_NEVER ? { expectActive: (r) => assert.fail(`ran (${r.status})`) } : undefined);
test('the watchdog reads unit states from the real service manager', (t) => {
  const units = machineUnits();
  units?.expectActive(
    spawnSync('systemctl', ['is-active', 'nonexistent-unit.service'], { encoding: 'utf8' }),
  );
  t.diagnostic('asked the service manager');
});
